questionsRapides.setupDesc: A question pops up with a countdown. When it says “Go!”, you both shout your answer, and the fastest right answer scores the point.
questionsRapides.longueurTitre: How many questions do you want to play?
questionsRapides.palierTexte: Stop here, or keep going with ten more questions?
questionsRapides.phraseEgalite: Neither of you is backing down... You'll need a rematch to settle this!
questionsRapides.phraseSerree: That was a close one. Rematch, just to be sure?
questionsRapides.phraseClaire: {{nom}} answered faster most of the time, but {{autre}} isn't done yet!
questionsRapides.phraseNette: A clear win! {{autre}} is probably going to want a rematch...
questionsRapides.resultatEgalites: {{n}} times, you both answered at the same time.
